name: Zscaler, Inc.
businessSummary: Cloud-native security platform (Zero Trust Exchange) for secure internet/app access; subscription SaaS model.

sharesOutstanding.note: millions; differs slightly from GAAP/non-GAAP diluted counts reported.

netDebt.note: Net cash $1.61B; convertible notes carrying value $1,699.9M vs cash/ST investments $3,321.3M.

evEbitdaTrailing.note: Extreme multiple -- GAAP EBITDA near breakeven, not a meaningful input.

fcfTTM.note: Only quarterly FCF confirmed: Q1 FY26 $413.3M (52% of rev) vs $291.9M (46%) a year earlier.

fcfYield.note: Inconsistent with annualizing the primary-source Q1 figure -- flagged conflict.

forwardEstimates.source: company guidance: FY2026 revenue $3.282-3.301B, non-GAAP EPS $3.78-3.82

recentEvents: Q1 FY2026 (ended Oct 31, 2025): revenue $788.1M +26% YoY, non-GAAP op margin 22%, GAAP op margin -5%, FCF $413.3M (52% of rev), GAAP net loss -$0.07 EPS, non-GAAP EPS $0.96.
Q2 FY2026 guidance: revenue $797-799M, non-GAAP EPS $0.89-0.90.
Non-GAAP tax rate lowered to 21% from 23%, flattering non-GAAP EPS comparisons.
valueTrapFlags: Persistent GAAP net losses and operating losses every year shown, though narrowing.
Large GAAP-to-non-GAAP gap driven partly by stock-based comp add-back.
Revenue growth decelerated steadily from 62% (FY22) to 23% (FY25) before a slight reacceleration to 26% in Q1 FY26.
growthQualityNotes: FCF margin strong and improving: 46% to 52% of revenue -- genuine cash generation despite GAAP losses.
Non-GAAP operating margin expanding (21% to 22% YoY), consistent with operating leverage.
Billings growth and net retention rate not disclosed in the release reviewed -- data gap on forward-looking SaaS signals.
dataGaps: Calculated billings and net retention not found.
Net debt/lease-adjusted figures not separately available.

valuation.method: Non-GAAP EPS-based scenario fair value (GAAP basis not usable given GAAP losses), explicitly treating the GAAP/non-GAAP gap as a quality discount

bear.note: Revenue growth decelerates further (toward the FY25 23% trough or below), non-GAAP multiple compresses.

base.note: Mid-20s% revenue growth sustains as in Q1 FY26, FCF margin keeps improving.

bull.note: Zero Trust/SASE adoption accelerates, GAAP profitability finally arrives, re-rating toward peer SaaS multiples.

valuation.whyItFits: Strong, improving FCF generation (52% of revenue) and a real reacceleration in growth (23% to 26% YoY) inside a structurally growing cybersecurity category, but persistent GAAP losses and an inconsistent FCF-yield figure are real data-quality caveats.
valuation.growthDrivers: Zero Trust/SASE category adoption, enterprise cloud security spend shift away from legacy perimeter security.
valuation.saturation: Revenue growth has decelerated steadily for 3 years before this quarter's uptick -- not yet confirmed as a durable reacceleration.
valuation.principalRisk: Still GAAP-unprofitable with an inconsistent FCF-yield data point; if the Q1 FY26 growth uptick doesn't hold, the current non-GAAP-anchored valuation has little support.
